newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Schiphol/Nedlloyd Districentres work on 'Apollo Formula.
newsitem.headline: Schiphol/Nedlloyd Districentres work on 'Apollo Formula.

text.p: Schiphol airport and Nedlloyd Districentres are working together in a bid to operate a facility at the new freight area Schiphol South-East, which is due to open late 1997 or early next year.

A Schiphol airport spokeswoman said the project, named Apollo Formula, will involve Schiphol airport owning the warehouse and distribution facility building, while Nedlloyd Districentres will be the logistic service provider operating the facility for shippers.
However, the spokeswoman stressed that the project is in a very early stage and would not comment on any further details. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
